turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hello, this is Asha, a virtual assistant from Suraksha Health Insurance, calling about the health insurance enquiry you submitted. This call is recorded for quality and training purposes. Is this a good time to talk for about five minutes?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: First, who would you like to cover: just yourself, or also your spouse, children or parents?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: What is the age of the eldest person to be covered?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Which city do you live in?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Does anyone to be covered have an existing medical condition, such as diabetes, blood pressure, thyroid or asthma?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Do you have any existing health insurance, including cover from your employer?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Is there a waiting period for that?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hospitalisation due to any illness is covered after an initial waiting period of 30 days from the policy start date. Pre-existing diseases are covered after a waiting period of 3 years of continuous coverage. Do you have any existing health insurance, including cover from your employer?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, we don't have any insurance

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Last one: which cover amount are you looking at, 5, 10, 15 or 25 lakh rupees? You can also say not sure.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for telling me. Because a medical condition was declared, an underwriter needs to review this before we can quote. This is not a rejection. I've scheduled an underwriter to call you back within 2 working days. Thank you, goodbye.
